# Stax

> Stax is a mobile-first app for investing in real companies through tokenized stocks on Base (with Mantle as a second network), guided by Vera, an AI investing assistant. You describe a goal in plain words; Vera turns it into a portfolio of tokenized shares and places it in one tap.

Stax is built for people who are new to investing and to crypto. There is no seed phrase and no gas: you sign in with email, and Stax covers the fees. Holdings are real tokenized shares, issued one-to-one by Coinbase on Base (and by Backed on Mantle), held in self-custody and recorded on-chain, with settlement in USDC. Every recommendation Vera makes is signed (EIP-712) and checked by a contract before money moves, so her track record is public and can't be edited.

## Key facts

- Invest by describing a goal in plain language to Vera, an AI investing assistant.
- Buy fractional, tokenized shares of well-known US companies (for example NVDA, GOOGL, AAPL, META, and SpaceX), plus Bitcoin (cbBTC) and Ether, and "Safe Dollars" (USDC earning a variable rate on Aave).
- Email login: no seed phrase, no browser extension, no manual wallet setup.
- Gasless, with fees on us: no gas costs and no account fees. A flat 25 bps on what you invest.
- Real shares: issued one-to-one by Coinbase on Base and by Backed on Mantle, held in self-custody, recorded on-chain.
- Eligibility: tokenized stocks are offered by Coinbase on Base and by Backed on Mantle to eligible people outside the United States. People in the US or other restricted regions can try the demo but cannot buy stocks.
- Accountable AI: Vera signs the risk of every plan and a contract verifies or refuses it before swaps execute; the record is public on-chain.
- Autopilot: optional automated, recurring investing (dollar-cost averaging).
- Baskets: ready-made mixes (for example Big Tech, AI & Chips, Safe Growth) you can invest in with one tap, save from a Vera plan, or share as a link; Vera still signs the risk before each invest.
- Built on Base, Coinbase's Ethereum network; Mantle is kept as a second network for earlier investments. You can start from as little as $1.
- Built with Privy (email login), Pimlico (gas sponsorship), Chainlink (reference prices), Uniswap (Base markets) and Aave (Safe Dollars).
